description: This file contains the class AOD_LogicHooks, which defines hook methods for handling save, delete, and restore events related to the AOD_Index module in SuiteCRM. The methods interact with the BeanFactory to obtain the index object and perform indexing or removal operations, with error handling included.

classes.name: AOD_LogicHooks
classes.description: Class implementing logic hooks for the AOD_Index module, handling save, delete, and restore events for indexing purposes.

methods.name: saveModuleChanges
methods.description: Handles indexing when a module record is saved, except for the AOD_Index module itself.

methods.name: saveModuleDelete
methods.description: Handles removal from the index when a module record is deleted, except for the AOD_Index module itself.

methods.name: saveModuleRestore
methods.description: Reindexes a module record during restore operations, except for the AOD_Index module itself.
